title: Iulius Firmicus Maternus, Mathesis (8 books) / RU: Фирмик Матерн, «Матесис» (RU-gap)
author: Iulius Firmicus Maternus, Sicilian senator
genre: Astrological handbook with a philosophical-apologetic frame
edition: Kroll–Skutsch–Ziegler, Teubner 1897–1913, public domain: https://archive.org/details/matheseoslibrivi02firmuoft. Monat, Budé 1992–97
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia (Юлий Фирмик Матерн) lists no translation. Absent from the ancientrome, vostlit and simposium catalogues.
en_evidence: Bram, Ancient Astrology (1975); Holden 2011; Dykes, Mathesis (Cazimi Press 2023; Open Library).
value: The largest Latin astrological work. Evidence for religion and society under Constantine (professions, slavery, sexuality) and for astrological doctrine; written before the author's Christian polemic. For historians of religion and science.
ai_feasibility: high: clear prose with systematic terminology; the existing translations allow cross-checking.
pilot_unit: Book 1 (the defence of astrology, incl. the account of Plotinus' death; est. 10k words)
